title: The Download Manager WordPress plugin before 3.3.73, Download Manager WordPress plugin before 7.6.2 does not verify…
description: A vulnerability in the Download Manager WordPress plugin versions before 3.3.73 and before 7.6.2 allows unauthenticated visitors to download password-protected and role-restricted files. This occurs because the plugin does not verify access permissions before issuing download keys via media-preview renderers, exposing sensitive files to unauthorized users.
